title: D.I.S. Technicians Led Growth
reason: The video describes a company's approach to training and management of their technicians and salespeople.

tasks.task: Train and maintain a skilled workforce.

subtasks.text: Ensure technicians receive ongoing training to keep up with technology updates.
Focus on selling only equipment for which there are qualified service personnel.

tasks.task: Maintain honesty and principle-driven business practices.

subtasks.text: Stick to customer honesty as a core principle.
Regularly assess and certify technicians in all areas of service.
Provide support for salespeople to attend relevant training.

tasks.task: Focus on technological advancements and customer satisfaction.

subtasks.text: Emphasize technology-driven and people-focused business practices.
